results.content: # Hate speech detection: Challenges and solutions. title={Hate speech detection: Challenges and solutions},. This work identifies and examines challenges faced by online automatic approaches for hate speech detection in text, and proposes a multi-view SVM approach that achieves near state-of-the-art performance, while being simpler and producing more easily interpretable decisions than neural methods. ### A short review on hate speech detection: challenges towards datasets and techniques. It is found that there are still issues with defining and detection hate speech and the investigation of machine learning methods for hate speech detection is still a fruitful research area. ### Deep Learning Approaches for Hate Speech Detection. ### Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Hate Speech Detection Using a Data Augmentation Approach. This work proposes an unsupervised domain adaptation approach to augment labeled data for hate speech detection, and shows its approach improves Area under the Precision/Recall curve by as much as 42% and recall by asmuch as 278%, with no loss (and in some cases a significant gain) in precision. ### Deep learning for hate speech detection: a comparative study. A large-scale empirical comparison of deep and shallow hate-speech detection methods, mediated through the three most commonly used datasets is presented, to illuminate progress in the area, and identify strengths and weaknesses in the current state of the art. ### Exploring hate speech detection: challenges, resources, current research and future directions. ### Explainability of Hate Speech Detection Models. ### A Review of Challenges in Machine Learning based Automated Hate Speech Detection.
